sonnet.problem: The card says the word of the LORD comes to Ezekiel "again." Ezekiel 38:1 gives no such time marker, and each lesson stands on its own, so this implies an earlier message that this card never establishes.
sonnet.rule: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

sonnet.problem: The card lists the nations and armies as a plain list. Its joke then says Gog 'rolls in with NATIONS' in the present tense. The verses are God's prediction (Persia, Cush and Put 'will accompany them'), and the card tells it as if it already happened.
sonnet.rule: A prediction stays a prediction: "God says Tyre will fall," never "Tyre falls."
